items.summary: Provision and deploy the app to a new Internet Computer canister ID (i.e., do not reuse the previously deployed canister), so the live site is served from the new canister.
Update the frontend canister/agent configuration used by `createActorWithConfig` so the UI talks to the newly deployed backend canister ID after redeploying.

If a custom domain is configured for the project, ensure the custom-domain verification file and deployment instructions remain consistent with the new canister deployment (i.e., do not break existing custom domain setup for `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in`).
